parts.availability_evidence: Declared policy: the structure is available from the earliest availability of any row, so every run that can read a row can read its structure. The earliest row comes from the first ALFRED vintage, whose realtime_start is 2019-09-06, and is available at the end of that date in UTC (D052).
parts.text:
**Identity.** Dataset `alfred.sahmrealtime` holds the FRED series `SAHMREALTIME` with every ALFRED vintage. Its catalog owner is Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis ALFRED. The dataset file has schema version 1. This contract has schema version 2.

**Meaning.** Real-time Sahm Rule Recession Indicator. It signals a recession when the three-month moving average of the national unemployment rate (U3) rises 0.50 percentage points or more above the minimum of the three-month averages of the previous 12 months, computed from the unemployment rates available in each month.

**Grain and keys.** One row is one real-time period of one monthly observation. `key` is the observation date as ISO text, the first day of the month, and is the business key. `revision` numbers the observation's real-time periods from 1 in order, so (`key`, `revision`) is the revision key.

**Measures.** `value` is decimal text in percentage points, seasonally adjusted, or null for a missing observation.

**Time.** Monthly observations from 1959-12-01. ALFRED vintages begin on 2019-09-06. `published_at` and `arrived_at` are both the end of the period's ALFRED `realtime_start` date in UTC. Time behavior is `full_history`, because ALFRED keeps every vintage. Supported modes are historical simulation through the run's cutoff, which reads each key's latest revision available by the cutoff, and reconstruction of a read through its record's vintage digest (D045, D052).

**Access.** `read_dataset` returns the latest available revision of each permitted month. Project policy selects UTC first-of-month labels within the union of the campaign's closed permission intervals. Release and arrival times independently determine availability at the run's cutoff. Campaigns pinned entirely to legacy contracts and unscoped operator reads retain dataset-only authority. It takes no column or interval argument. A rendered result larger than 262,144 bytes is withheld whole.

**Relationships.** It is derived from `UNRATE`. The platform recomputes it from `alfred.unrate` and reconciles the two (D053). Join recipes are unknown, which blocks joins with other datasets.

**Evidence.** The title, units, frequency, seasonal adjustment, first observation, and notes come from FRED series metadata retrieved 23 October 2026. The first vintage date comes from the ALFRED download retrieved 23 October 2026, SHA-256 `6028faecf6d4891fa0859a5534e12a5e3ecd46fabd23548aa37a37026aa1e784`. The grain, keys, and times come from the conversion in `quant_research.public_data` (D052). Review status is unknown.

parts.availability_evidence: The ALFRED download retrieved 23 October 2026 first lists the null value in the vintage whose realtime_start is 2025-12-16, available at the end of that date in UTC (D052).
